description: Validate a layered architecture against core use cases by producing call chains. Use when the user has a proposed architecture (services assigned to layers) and needs to prove it supports the required behavior. Trigger on: "validate architecture", "call chain", "does this design support", "core use cases", "use case validation", "composable design", "prove the architecture", "test the design", or any request to verify that a set of services can satisfy a set of use cases. Also trigger when the user asks how a specific use case flows through the architecture - that is a call chain request.
